title: Implement a stdlib-only HTTP JSON todo API from a spec
prompt: Implement the HTTP JSON API described in SPEC.md as a single file `server.py`, using only the Python standard library. It is started as `python server.py --port PORT` and must serve on 127.0.0.1. Write a few tests of your own if you like, but at least start the server and try every endpoint with curl or urllib before you finish.
